title: calcReserveAtRatioLiquidity underflows on a ratio inside its table
rootCause: For this price range Stable2LUT1.getRatiosFromPriceLiquidity returns a very large lowPriceJ and bounds far apart, so Stable2.updateReserve takes a correction larger than the reserve, and calcReserveAtRatioLiquidity reverts with an arithmetic panic.

poc.observable: test_a_price_in_the_table_does_not_underflow fails with "panic: arithmetic underflow or overflow (0x11)"
